findings.label: Archived chat enters NEEDS YOU through the Review
findings.action: In round4/verification.md (Archive row and Limitations), state that archiving a chat whose stopped Run left a candidate now lists the archived chat under NEEDS YOU with the proposal card. Reword the reason that a notice 'would raise a just-archived chat'.

findings.label: Proposed contract sentences overstate reachability
findings.action: Before integration, limit the invariants.md sentence to Runs that end Interrupted, Failed or Cancelled, or through a checked stop. A Completed Run's unapplied candidate gets no chat attention (T7 case c). Also add finish()'s Interrupted and Failed results to the threads-behavior.md sentence.

findings.label: 'Needs a desktop change' is the wrong reason for the failure and resume-stale stops
findings.action: pause_failed_worker and the resume-stale stop reach stop_chat_run with no live in-process worker. The service could recognise a lease-free Run there (run_is_live, or recover_orphaned_runs first) and give it the notice and the lease cleanup. Correct the limitation text and record the follow-up as a service-side change.

findings.label: Killed queued Run + Resume is untested
findings.action: When the killed Run is the pending queue item, Resume goes through the desktop's resume-stale stop_chat_run instead of orphan recovery. The Review is added, no notice is added, the lease file stays, and the item is re-dispatched. Add this case to the limitations and the native procedure's expectations, or cover the same sequence with an app-level test.

findings.label: Helper's own Cancelled supersession has no fail-before record
findings.action: U1 is marked n/a, and T3 exercises only finish()'s Cancelled match. Reading the code, each U1 case fails when its rule is removed. Record one mutation result for a_notice_on_a_cancelled_run_is_replaced.

findings.label: Sandbox-dependent checks still unverified
